english.title: Person acting under auth. by casino premises licence holder fail to produce copy of authorisation - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), while carrying on an activity in reliance on an authorisation under section 174(3) of the Gambling Act 2005, failed without reasonable excuse to produce a copy of your authorisation after having been required by

(A)_[a constable]_
(B)_[an enforcement officer]_

to do so

(C)_[within a specified period, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD..)]_
(D)_[immediately]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 316(4), (5) and (6) of the Gambling Act 2005.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 174(3) of the Gambling Act 2005 provides that the holder of a casino premises licence may authorise a person in writing to use the premises for the provision of facilities for bingo and/or betting.
(ii) "Copy" is not defined by the Act and should be given its ordinary meaning.
